is_anopheles.evidence: The study focuses on Anopheles arabiensis, Anopheles gambiae s.s., and Anopheles funestus s.s. in western Kenya.

reports_target_markers.evidence: The paper mentions previous studies on insecticide resistance (Kawada et al., 2011a, 2011b) but does not report new genotype data for any of the required markers in this study.

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: The paper does not provide any genotype counts or frequencies for insecticide-resistance markers.

african_field_population.evidence: The study was conducted in Gembe East, Homa Bay County, western Kenya.

is_primary_study.evidence: This is a cluster randomized-controlled trial.

sub_country_location.evidence: The study area is Gembe East, Homa Bay County, western Kenya.

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: The study covers the period from 2009 to 2012.

duplicate_risk.evidence: This is a primary cluster randomized-controlled trial.

supplement.evidence: The paper does not contain genotype data, and no supplementary file is needed to fulfill the criteria as the paper is ineligible due to the lack of marker data.

assessment.summary: This paper reports on a cluster randomized-controlled trial evaluating the effectiveness of insecticide-treated ceiling nets in western Kenya. While it discusses malaria vectors and mentions previous studies on insecticide resistance, it does not report any new genotype data for resistance markers.
